issues.title: Phase 0: fix version catalog and get a clean build on both platforms
issues.body:
## Context
Scaffold was generated without a network-verified Gradle sync (design v1.0, §14/§17 Phase 0).

## Task
Align `gradle/libs.versions.toml` with current stable versions (compare with the KMP wizard), then get `./gradlew build` and an Xcode build green from a clean checkout.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew :shared:allTests` passes (incl. FractionalIndexTest)
- [ ] iosApp builds and runs in the simulator (see iosApp/README.md)

issues.title: Phase 0: initialize Firebase on Android and iOS, wire Koin startup
issues.body:
## Context
Design §5/§6 — Firebase from common code via GitLive; DI via Koin.

## Task
Create the `tripplanner-dev` Firebase project (docs/phase0-spike.md prerequisites), add config files, start Koin with `sharedModule(placesApiKey)` in MainActivity and iOSApp, verify `FirestoreTripRepository` compiles against the pinned GitLive version.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A `trips` doc written on Android appears live on iOS via the shared Flow in < 2 s (exit criterion E2)
- [ ] Rules + indexes deployed from `firebase/`

issues.title: Phase 0: implement GoogleSignInProvider on both platforms
issues.body:
## Context
Design §6.4 — Credential Manager + googleid on Android; GoogleSignIn SDK on iOS; ID token exchanged with Firebase Auth.

## Task
Implement `shared/platform/GoogleSignInProvider` actuals and a minimal sign-in button on the trip list empty state.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sign-in completes on both platforms and yields a Firebase user (exit criterion E4)
- [ ] Sign-out works and the trip list returns to the signed-out state

issues.title: Phase 0: map behind the shared MapView boundary + interop stress test
issues.body:
## Context
Design §6.4 — Maps Compose on Android; GMSMapView via UIKitViewController factory on iOS. This validates decision log #1.

## Task
Replace the iOS placeholder in `MapViewFactory.swift` with a real GMSMapView; render markers and route tap callbacks into Kotlin on both platforms; run the interop stress test (docs/phase0-spike.md task 7).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Exit criteria E3 and E5 met, or the §16 fallback is triggered and recorded in the design decision log

issues.title: Phase 1: trip creation and trip list
issues.body:
## Context
Design §3.1 (1–2), §7.

## Task
Create-trip flow (name, dates, timeZone defaulting to device zone), trip list with empty state, owner role written on create.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Trip doc matches the §7 schema incl. `timeZone`, `memberIds`, `roles`
- [ ] Rules allow create only when ownerId == auth.uid and creator is a member

issues.title: Phase 1: Places autocomplete and add-stop flow
issues.body:
## Context
Design §8.1 — client-direct Places API (New) with session tokens.

## Task
Search sheet using `PlacesApi.autocomplete` (min 3 chars, debounce ≥ 200 ms), details fetch on selection, write the stop with a fractional order key at the end of the chosen day.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One autocomplete session + details call bill as a single session (session token passed to both)
- [ ] Stop appears offline-first (local snapshot) then syncs
- [ ] Only placeId + coordinates stored durably (§7 caching note)

issues.title: Phase 1: day tabs with drag-and-drop reorder
issues.body:
## Context
Design §3.1 (4), §7 fractional indexing.

## Task
Trip detail screen: day tabs, reorder within and across days via `TripDetailViewModel.moveStop` (single-document writes), NOT_FOUND on concurrent delete surfaced as a toast.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two devices reordering concurrently converge without lost stops
- [ ] `FractionalIndexTest` invariants hold in an on-device soak (500 random moves)

issues.title: Phase 1: map screen for the selected day
issues.body:
## Context
Design §3.1 (4), §6.4.

## Task
Day's stops as markers, camera bounds to fit, selection sync between list and map, polyline between consecutive stops.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Works on both platforms via the shared MapView boundary

issues.title: Phase 1: offline UX pass
issues.body:
## Context
Design §9.

## Task
Pending-sync indicator from snapshot metadata, disabled states + messaging for autocomplete/export while offline, listener scoping (active trip only) verified.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Airplane-mode edit/reopen/sync round-trip works on both platforms
- [ ] No listeners remain attached after leaving a trip (check Firestore usage logs)

issues.title: Phase 2: invites (Functions + App Links/Universal Links)
issues.body:
## Context
Design §8.2 — createInvite/redeemInvite are already skeletoned in firebase/functions.

## Task
Share sheet on the trip screen, Hosting landing page for /join/{code}, App Link + Universal Link verification (replace placeholders in AndroidManifest.xml and .well-known/), redemption flow into the trip.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fresh install → invite link → lands in the joined trip on both platforms
- [ ] Expired/exhausted codes rejected with a clear message

issues.title: Phase 2: activity feed and FCM fan-out
issues.body:
## Context
Design §10 — onStopWritten already writes activity events; fan-out is stubbed.

## Task
Finish token collection/pruning and burst collapsing in the Function; platform token registration (FirebaseMessagingService / APNs); notification prefs; feed screen.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Editing on device A notifies device B (data message, deep-links to the stop)
- [ ] 3+ rapid edits collapse into one digest
- [ ] Unregistered tokens are pruned

issues.title: Phase 2: travel times via Routes API
issues.body:
## Context
Design §8.3 — recompute only affected adjacencies, 24 h cache, driving + walking only (decision log #2).

## Task
Implement the Routes call in `onStopWritten` with the ROUTES_API_KEY secret; render travel legs between stops with a shimmer while missing.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Moving one stop triggers ≤ 5 Routes calls (§15)
- [ ] Legs cache-hit within 24 h; stale legs for removed adjacencies are deleted

issues.title: Phase 3: Google Calendar export
issues.body:
## Context
Design §8.4 — incremental auth for calendar.events; events in the trip's timeZone; re-export updates via stored eventIds.

## Task
Implement `GoogleAuthorizer` on both platforms, the export use case over `CalendarApi`, and eventId bookkeeping on stops. Start Google OAuth verification for the sensitive scope (§11, §16).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Export creates correctly-timed events (09:00 day start + durations + travel) in the trip's timeZone
- [ ] Re-export updates rather than duplicates
- [ ] Tokens are requested per export and never persisted

issues.title: Phase 3: Claude day-order suggestions behind a flag
issues.body:
## Context
Design §8.5 — suggestDayOrder Function is skeletoned; Remote Config flag suggest_order_enabled.

## Task
Wire the Gemini call with responseSchema, permutation validation, preview UI with apply-as-batch.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Invalid/hallucinated IDs are rejected server-side
- [ ] Flag off = no UI entry point

issues.title: Phase 4: hardening — rules tests, emulator CI, observability, store prep
issues.body:
## Context
Design §12–§14, §17 Phase 4.

## Task
Rules allow/deny matrix with @firebase/rules-unit-testing, GitHub Actions (Linux: gradle check + emulator tests; macOS: Android release + xcodebuild archive), Crashlytics/Analytics events (§12), App Check enforcement, Sign in with Apple, Play/TestFlight submissions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI green on a clean clone
- [ ] App Check enforced on Firestore + callables
- [ ] Internal-testing builds live on both stores
